content.text:
The branch looks clean. Here's a summary of what changed across the last several commits to make the CF deployment functionally equivalent to Node.js mode:

**What now works in CF (was returning `[]` or 501):**

- `GET /api/adapters` → real adapter list from the in-memory registry (all 10 built-ins: claude_local, http, openclaw_gateway, etc.)
- `GET /api/adapters/:type/config-schema` → in-memory adapter registry lookup
- `GET /api/plugins` → real plugin list from DB
- `GET /api/plugins/ui-contributions` → derived from `manifestJson` stored in DB at install time
- `GET /api/companies/:id/members` → `accessRoutes` via Express bridge
- `GET /api/companies/:id/invites`, `POST` create, `POST` revoke → bridge
- Join request approve/reject, board claims, CLI auth, admin users → bridge

**Still intentionally limited:**
- Plugin install/manage — requires process spawning
- Adapter install from npm — requires filesystem
- Skill create/delete — requires filesystem
- Database backups — requires backup service
